name: Mr. Smite
summary: At Ironclad Cove, Mr. Smite keeps watch over the Defias ship and its crew. The tauren serves Captain Greenskin as first mate, guarding the docks where Edwin VanCleef's dreadnaught is being fitted out. Any intruder who meets him faces a changing array of weapons and formidable strength.

sections.title: First Mate of the Cove
sections.body: Mr. Smite keeps order on the docks of Ironclad Cove as first mate to the goblin Captain Greenskin. The Defias Brotherhood is made up mostly of disaffected humans and goblin tinkerers, yet Smite is a battle-hardened tauren far from Kalimdor's plains. He has charge of a rowdy pirate crew while they fit out Edwin VanCleef's secret dreadnaught, and he allows no disruption to the work.

sections.title: A Deadly Weaponmaster
sections.body: Mr. Smite fights with more than brute force; he is a showman and a versatile weaponmaster. He toys with challengers, drawing out the fight and offering them a false hope of victory. When pressed, he stamps the ground with such force that foes are stunned, then searches a nearby chest for another weapon. He begins with a quick dueling blade, moves to twin cleaving reavers, and brings out a huge two-handed warhammer when pushed far enough.

faq.q: Why is a tauren working with human bandits in Westfall?
faq.answer: Most tauren live in Kalimdor with their Horde allies, but mercenary outcasts and wanderers sometimes travel east. Mr. Smite is Captain Greenskin's first mate, keeping the crew in line at Ironclad Cove as they ready the dreadnaught for sea.

aliases: who does mr smite work for
faq.answer: Mr. Smite answers to Captain Greenskin, the goblin captain of the pirate vessel anchored in Ironclad Cove. Edwin VanCleef leads the Defias Brotherhood and stands above them in its wider conspiracy.

faq.q: What weapons does Mr. Smite use during the fight?
aliases: what does smite pull out of the chest
faq.answer: Mr. Smite begins with a Thief's Blade, then retreats to his chest for a pair of Smite's Reavers. When pressed to his limits, he draws Smite's Mighty Hammer.

faq.q: Where can Mr. Smite be found?
faq.answer: Mr. Smite watches the wooden piers of Ironclad Cove, the last cavern in the Deadmines. He guards the gangplank to the giant Defias dreadnaught.
Mr. Smite has two Defias rogues hidden nearby, ready to ambush trespassers advancing along the pier toward the ship.

faq.q: What makes Mr. Smite so dangerous in close quarters?
faq.answer: His tauren War Stomp sends shockwaves across the wooden dock and stuns the whole party, giving Mr. Smite time to rearm from his footlocker and return with heavier weapons.

angles.text: For a traveler from Mulgore, seeing a tauren serve as first mate among seafaring outlaws in the Eastern Kingdoms is jarring.
Mr. Smite shows disciplined skill, moving from quick one-handed strikes to paired axes and punishing blows with a two-handed hammer.
Mr. Smite blocks Alliance agents from reaching the gangplank and Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef beyond it.
